mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_workspaces(owner_user_id) VALUES(#{uid}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT document::text AS document,revision FROM team_workspaces WHERE owner_user_id=#{uid} FOR UPDATE
SELECT request_hash,result::text AS result FROM team_requests WHERE owner_user_id=#{uid} AND request_key=#{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_events(owner_user_id,team_id,revision,kind,payload) SELECT #{uid},NULLIF(#{team},'')::uuid,revision,#{kind},#{payload}::jsonb FROM team_workspaces WHERE owner_user_id=#{uid}
mapper.select: SELECT id,team_id::text,revision,kind,payload::text,created_at::text FROM team_events WHERE owner_user_id=#{uid} AND id>#{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT 200

WITH picked AS ( SELECT j.id FROM team_jobs j WHERE (j.state='queued' OR (j.state='running' AND j.lease_until<now() AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_actions a WHERE a.job_id=j.id AND a.state IN ('dispatched','unknown')))) AND (j.payload->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'turn' OR COALESCE((j.payload->>'generation')::int,1)= COALESCE((SELECT (w.document->'tasks'->(j.payload->>'taskId')->>'generation')::int FROM team_workspaces w WHERE w.owner_user_id=j.owner_user_id),1)) AND (j.payload->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'turn' OR NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM team_jobs other WHERE other.id!=j.id AND other.owner_user_id=j.owner_user_id AND other.payload->>'taskId'=j.payload->>'taskId' AND other.payload->>'kind'='turn' AND ((other.state='running' AND other.lease_until>now()) OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM team_actions a WHERE a.job_id=other.id AND a.state IN ('dispatched','unknown'))))) ORDER BY j.created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE team_jobs j SET state='running',worker_id=#{worker},fence=fence+1, lease_until=now()+interval '40 seconds',updated_at=now() FROM picked WHERE j.id=picked.id RETURNING j.id::text,j.owner_user_id,j.team_id::text,j.payload::text,j.checkpoint::text,j.sandbox_id,j.fence
SELECT id::text,owner_user_id,team_id::text,payload::text,checkpoint::text,result::text,sandbox_id,state,worker_id,fence,lease_until>now() AS lease_valid FROM team_jobs WHERE id=#{id}::uuid
mapper.update: UPDATE team_jobs SET lease_until=now()+interval '40 seconds' WHERE id=#{id}::uuid AND worker_id=#{worker} AND fence=#{fence} AND lease_until>now() AND state='running'
UPDATE team_jobs SET state=#{state},result=#{result}::jsonb,updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id}::uuid AND worker_id=#{worker} AND fence=#{fence} AND state='running'
UPDATE team_jobs SET sandbox_id=#{sandbox},updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id}::uuid
mapper.select: SELECT id::text,request_key,kind,input::text,state,result::text FROM team_actions WHERE job_id=#{job}::uuid ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT id::text,request_hash,kind,input::text,state,result::text FROM team_actions WHERE job_id=#{job}::uuid AND request_key=#{key}
SELECT count(*) FROM team_jobs WHERE owner_user_id=#{uid} AND payload->>'runId'=#{run} AND state='running'
mapper.update: UPDATE team_jobs j SET state='needs_reconciliation',updated_at=now() WHERE j.state='running' AND lease_until<now() AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_actions a WHERE a.job_id=j.id AND a.state IN ('dispatched','unknown'))
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON(payload->>'taskId') id::text AS job_id,sandbox_id,payload->>'taskId' AS task_id,state,lease_until>now() AS lease_valid FROM team_jobs WHERE owner_user_id=#{uid} AND jsonb_exists(payload,'taskId') ORDER BY payload->>'taskId',created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE team_jobs SET state='queued',updated_at=now() WHERE owner_user_id=#{uid} AND payload->>'taskId'=#{task} AND COALESCE((payload->>'generation')::int,1)=#{generation} AND state='paused'
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM team_jobs WHERE owner_user_id=#{uid} AND payload->>'taskId'=#{task} AND payload->>'kind'='turn' AND COALESCE((payload->>'generation')::int,1)=#{generation} AND state IN ('queued','running','paused','needs_reconciliation')
SELECT count(*) FROM team_jobs WHERE owner_user_id=#{uid} AND payload->>'taskId'=#{task} AND state='running'
SELECT count(*) FROM team_actions a JOIN team_jobs j ON j.id=a.job_id WHERE j.owner_user_id=#{uid} AND j.payload->>'taskId'=#{task} AND a.state IN ('dispatched','unknown')
